mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 50,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a synchronized expansion in manufacturing and construction sectors, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates improving inflation dynamics that support corporate pricing power and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650.0 (thousand units), it signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending and housing market strength, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) has a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential inflationary pressures, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.
